\\<br/>\pi_{\mathrm{ring}}(u) &amp;\propto \exp\left(-\dfrac{u^2}{2\cdot 0.35^2}\right)<br/>\end{aligned}" style="line-height: 1.15 !important; margin-top: 0px !important;"><font style="font-size: 20px;">$$\begin{aligned}<br/>\operatorname{centroid}(x) &amp;= \left[ \dfrac{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}\,\xi_j}{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}}, \dfrac{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}\,\eta_i}{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}} \right] \\<br/>w_{ij} &amp;= \left(\dfrac{1}{3}\sum_{c=1}^{3} x_{cij}\right)^2 \\<br/>\hat{r}(p) &amp;= \dfrac{\arg\max_r \tilde{p}(r)}{R-1} \\<br/>\tilde{p}(r) &amp;= p(r) \text{ after suppressing the first 4 radial bins} \\<br/>\pi_{\mathrm{ring}}(u) &amp;\propto \exp\left(-\dfrac{u^2}{2\cdot 0.35^2}\right)<br/>\end{aligned}$$</font></div></div></div><div class="math-block" data-math="\begin{aligned}&lt;br/&gt;\mathcal{L} &amp;= 1.00\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{main}} + 0.10\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rel}} + 0.10\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{contam}} + 0.02\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{center}} + 0.02\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{radius}} + 0.02\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{arc}} \\&lt;br/&gt;\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{main}} &amp;= \mathrm{FL}(\ell_B, y) \\&lt;br/&gt;\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rel}} &amp;= \mathrm{FL}(\ell_{\mathrm{rel}}, y) \\&lt;br/&gt;\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{contam}} &amp;= \mathrm{CE}(c, \hat{c}) \\&lt;br/&gt;\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{center}} &amp;= \mathrm{SL1}([dx,dy], \operatorname{centroid}(x)) \\&lt;br/&gt;\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{radius}} &amp;= \mathbf{1}_{\{y=1\}}\mathrm{SL1}(r_0, \hat{r}(p)) \\&lt;br/&gt;\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{arc}} &amp;= \mathbf{1}_{\{y=1\}}\left[-\operatorname{mean}(a \cdot \pi_{\mathrm{ring}}) + 0.35\operatorname{mean}(a)\right] + \mathbf{1}_{\{y=0\}}\operatorname{mean}(a)&lt;br/&gt;\end{aligned}" style="line-height: 1.15 !important; margin-top: 0px !important;"><font face="Google Sans Text, sans-serif"><br></font></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>" div.data-math:
\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{centroid}(x) &= \left[ \dfrac{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}\,\xi_j}{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}}, \dfrac{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}\,\eta_i}{\sum_{i,j} w_{ij}} \right] \\
w_{ij} &= \left(\dfrac{1}{3}\sum_{c=1}^{3} x_{cij}\right)^2 \\
\hat{r}(p) &= \dfrac{\arg\max_r \tilde{p}(r)}{R-1} \\
\tilde{p}(r) &= p(r) \text{ after suppressing the first 4 radial bins} \\
\pi_{\mathrm{ring}}(u) &\propto \exp\left(-\dfrac{u^2}{2\cdot 0.35^2}\right)
\end{aligned}
div.style: line-height: 1.15 !important; margin-top: 0px !important;
